description: Automation lanes for 07_param_sweeps_midnote.mid. One sweep section per held note, so a listener can attribute what they hear to one moving parameter at a time. Breakpoint times are in SECONDS from the start of the render; values are linearly interpolated between breakpoints and held flat before the first and after the last. Every value below stays inside the parameter's own shipped APVTS range (plugin/src/Parameters.cpp) -- this is an abuse case in how FAR and how FAST the knobs move, not in moving them somewhere a user could not.

lanes.comment: Note 1 (MIDI 45, 0.5-8.0 s): tap swept from centre to hard-bridge to hard-neck and back. Checklist items 7 and 10.
Note 2 (MIDI 52, 8.5-16.0 s): the RLC resonance swept across most of its 100-8000 Hz range while the string rings.
Note 2, in step with the resonance sweep: broad to narrow and back.

Note 3 (MIDI 33, 16.5-24.0 s): drive swept 0 to 1 mid-note. Read against the RC2 caveat in docs/listening/physical-plausibility-checklist.md -- this stage is a static waveshaper and is NOT a drive-feel voicing reference.
Note 4 (MIDI 57, 24.5-31.0 s): material morph, low-frequency loop loss.
Note 4: high-frequency loop loss, swept in opposition to the low band so the spectral tilt moves rather than the overall decay time alone.
Note 4: dispersion from none to full and back, i.e. from an ideal string to a stiff one, mid-note.
